title: Hardware Used in AI (The Physical Engine Behind Intelligence)

# Hardware Used in AI

## The Quick Answer

AI runs on specialized computer chips:

- **CPU**: Regular processor (slow for AI)
- **GPU**: Graphics processor (10-100x faster for AI)
- **TPU**: Google's specialized chip (100-1000x faster for AI)

Different hardware = Different speed = Different cost = Different possibilities.

## Why This Matters

AI costs money because **someone has to pay for the hardware**.

Every API call runs on expensive servers. Those servers have expensive GPUs or TPUs. That's why AI isn't actually free—the cost is hidden in subscription fees.

## Hardware Comparison

### CPU (Central Processing Unit)

**Speed for AI:**
- Mistral Small: 2-5 seconds per response (too slow)
- Mistral Large: 5-10 minutes per response (impractical)

**Use case:** Development/learning only

### GPU (Graphics Processing Unit)

**Hardware cost:** $5K-$10K per GPU
**Speed for AI:**
- Mistral Small: 100-500ms (real-time)
- Mistral Large: 1-2 seconds (acceptable)

**Use case:** Production deployments, most AI companies

**Annual cost per GPU:**
- Hardware: $3K-$4K
- Electricity: $6K-$7K
- Cooling/maintenance: $2K-$3K
- Total: ~$10K per GPU per year

### TPU (Tensor Processing Unit)

**Speed for AI:** 10-100x faster than GPU for large models
**Availability:** Google Cloud only
**Cost:** $10-50/hour (but shared across users)

## Why Hardware Costs So Much

```
One GPU cluster (1000 GPUs for production):
- Hardware: $10 million
- Cooling: $1 million
- Power infrastructure: $500K
- Installation: $500K
- First-year staffing: $1 million
- Monthly electricity: $500K

Total Year 1: $14 million
Ongoing annual: $7 million
```

## Scaling Requires More Hardware

```
Serving 1,000 users: 2-4 GPUs
Serving 10,000 users: 20-40 GPUs
Serving 100,000 users: 200-400 GPUs
Serving 1 million users: 2000-4000 GPUs
```

## Key Insights

✓ GPU is standard (best price/performance)
✓ TPU is fastest (but expensive long-term commitment)
✓ CPU is too slow (development only)
✗ Hardware cost is why AI isn't free
✗ Scaling requires massive capital investment

**This is why:** Big companies dominate AI (only they can afford $100M+ hardware)
